packageRules.description: The minimum Home Assistant version moves only on purpose, from the dependency dashboard
These pins are taken from the pinned Home Assistant release and move by hand with it, never on their own
The devcontainer runs the Python Home Assistant runs, so only its patch releases and digest move on their own
The protobuf generators make the gencode the vendored protobufs need (see CONTRIBUTING.md) and move only with a regeneration
